Messages.Author: Santiago
Messages.Body:
This question has been bugging me ever since I started
playing a Gangrel deck:

I have a vampire with regular animalism who successfully
employs a raven spy or a murder of crows. Later in the
game, I play Animalism on the vampire. Does the retainer
nnow have one life or two? The vampire now has superior
animalism, so the retainer should have 2 life, but the
reatiner was played when the vampire only had regular
animalism, so it should have 1 life. Any insights?

Santiago * Reporter: Mr. Ghandi, what do you think of e-mail: * western civilization?
ia...@mail.utexas.edu * Ghandi: I think it would be a very good idea.

e) Its number of lives depends only on the skill of the recruiting
vampire at the time it is recruited; if the skill changes later,
the [Retainer] doesn't change.
